experiment: BBBC001v1: StarDist full-chain test with fresh vanilla and Astra+StarDist ablation

recovered_comparison.label: Recovered/composite vanilla: five primary answers plus one separately retried timeout

answer.explanation: A visual tally across the full image gives approximately 510 nuclei, assuming one Hoechst-stained nucleus per cell.
limitations: Manual estimate; dim, overlapping, and edge-truncated nuclei introduce counting uncertainty.

manifest.question: Count the cells in this fluorescence microscopy image of Hoechst-stained nuclei. Return your estimated total cell count as a number.
